analyse.lead: Type or paste a phrase, or a verse reference such as 2:255, and read it word by word. Quranic text is read from the Quranic Arabic Corpus at its place; other text is matched against the Quran's own words, with how sure each reading is.

analyse.method: How it works: Quranic words come from the Quranic Arabic Corpus at their place (hand-verified, confidence 1). Other words are matched to Quranic words spelled the same, the confidence being that analysis's share of those occurrences; failing that, after taking off conjunctions, prepositions, the article and attached pronouns (×0.7), then by the Quran's patterns over its roots (0.35 at most), then over the lexica's roots the Quran does not have (0.2 at most), then by the rules for weak and doubled roots — the same rules the hadith and the classical books are read by. books.title: Books
books.homeLead: Thirty-seven classical Arabic books — Quranic sciences, language, grammar, literature, history, law and hadith — from OpenITI's corrected versions: the author's text alone, the editor's footnote markers and verse references taken out by rules applied to every book. Every word opens its root in the Quran and the dictionaries; every paragraph comes with its citation.
